notes: Loop 2 (was 7.4). Checked the German phone report first, then EN/ES/PL, desktop, dark, slider-moved, landing, /try, connect-beta and the print card. I re-rendered /r#demo (print media, A4), walked /try at 390 px and opened report-static.de.html with every section expanded. What changed: all six loop-1 items are fixed (see loop1). The phone report fell from 23,943 to 11,763 px. It reads as a German six-step lesson with a predict-then-check moment, an honest bar chart, a slider that names the per-customer mechanism and a dated, sourced facts card. Dark is clean. Held back by: (1) /try asks for the Kiez for the rehearsal, but its report's step 5 says 'Bitten Sie Ihren KI-Coach' (reh.empty2), so owners without an AI app never see imagined customers. (2) On a phone, every visual in step 5 is collapsed, along with the uptake chart and the facts card, and opened grid cells break German words mid-word. (3) The landing's break-even mini chart puts the dot where the line is not at zero (index.html:145). (4) The terms drift between pages (Erdacht vs Ausgedacht, Gewinnschwelle vs Break-even). The round chart's labels say '1 of 6' in German. (5) Three pairs of interview answers are word-for-word the same.
improvements: /try report, step 5 (src/report/messages.ts:748-750, site/src/try.ts:404). /try is the path for owners without an AI app. It asks 'In welchem Kiez liegt Ihr Café?' because 'Die erdachten Gäste im Probelauf werden für Ihren Kiez zusammengestellt'. Then the report from /try shows 'Noch kein Probelauf … Bitten Sie Ihren KI-Coach' and '4 von 6 fertig'. In the closed beta, Selin never sees the most hands-on visual with her own numbers. Run the existing rule-based rehearsal in the browser for /try reports (startRehearsal + ruleBasedReactions with the chosen Kiez), labelled 'von festen Regeln gespielt, ohne KI'. Or add a 'Probelauf starten' button that fills the grid round by round. Why: rehearsal visuals and the hands-on criterion, on the closed-beta main path. Done when: finishing /try at 390 px gives a report with '6 von 6', a Neukölln grid and a step 5 caveat that says rule-based.

Step 5 and 6 on a phone (mount.ts:99-100 opens data-wi-open-wide only at ≥760 px; rehearsal.ts:285, sections.ts:249 and :668). At 390 px, five things sit behind tap-rows: the uptake dots, the R1-R4 grid with the ⚡ event, the interview, the tornado and the Berlin facts card. Step 5 reads as text only. When opened, the grid cells break German words (styles.ts:453 overflow-wrap:anywhere): 'woander s zu Mittag', 'Mittagsa ngebot', 'stattdess en', 'Bewertu ng'. 'Nicht da' cells are at opacity 0.62, which I measured at 2.55:1 (styles.ts:458). Open the uptake dots and the grid by default on phones, and collapse 'Wer hat was gemacht' or 'Gut zu wissen' instead to stay under 14 screens. Give the cells short labels per language ('Isst woanders', 'Bringt was mit', 'Wie immer', 'Erzählt davon') and use overflow-wrap:break-word. Keep 'Nicht da' at 4.5:1 or more. Why: rehearsal visuals and polish. Done when: report-phone.png shows the grid in step 5 with no mid-word breaks, and ui-report-height still passes.

Landing method mini charts (site/index.html:140 and :145). In the break-even sketch, the path M8 86 L212 14 crosses zero at x≈93, but the dot and the 'Gewinnschwelle' line are at x=122, where the line is already above zero. The first break-even picture an owner sees teaches the wrong geometry. At 390 px the label is also clipped to 'Gewinnschwelle:' with no number (landing-phone.png). The step-3 sketch overlaps 'vorsichtig' with '−385 €' and shows '257 €' without '+'. Put the dot where the line crosses zero, move the label into the viewBox, right-align the row names and sign every value. Why: charts must be honest and readable, and the landing should teach in a minute. Done when: a 3× crop of landing-phone.png shows the dot on the line at zero, the full label and no overlapping text.

One word per idea across the German landing page, /try and the report. The landing uses the chip 'Erdacht' and 'erdachte Gäste', plus 'Gewinnschwelle: 11 pro Tag'. The report uses 'Ausgedacht' and 'Break-even'. /try chips say 'Ein Fakt über Ihr Café' and 'Ihre Schätzung' where the report says 'Ihre Zahl' and 'Eine Schätzung'. Pick one set: Ausgedacht, and 'Break-even (Gewinnschwelle)' in the step-4 lead, as the glossary already says. Also translate the round chart's value label: src/report/charts.ts:416 hardcodes `${u.engaged} of ${u.active}`, so DE/ES/PL show '1 of 6' and '2 of 5'. Why: the source chips only teach if the labels never change, and no English belongs in German. Done when: grep finds no 'Erdacht' in site/ or ' of ' in the German static report, and the landing legend matches the report legend chip for chip.

Interview in the demo (report.txt, 'Interview: „Was würde Sie nächste Woche wieder…“ (6 Antworten)'). Chiara and Paweł, Noor and Greta, and Murat and Jan each give word-for-word the same answer. So '6 Antworten' are 3 templates, which reads like a machine and spoils 'watching a neighbourhood react'. Write the rule-based answers from each persona's own memory and round actions. For example, Noor could mention the R3 rival and her vegetarian wish, and Paweł could mention that he brings lunch. Or group them honestly: '2 ausgedachte Gäste sagten: …'. Why: rehearsal visuals and honesty about rule-based output. Done when: no two answers in report.txt are identical, or duplicates are shown once with a count.

Explanations with the owner's own numbers in /try (src/engine/messages.de.ts:337-338, src/report/sections.ts worst-case card). I gave /try the placeholder values: 140 a day, 7,40 € average bill, 38 at lunch, a 9,90 € deal. The slider text then reads '8 × 5,35 € pro Angebot − −10,03 € pro Tag zu decken' and 'Das ist mindestens die Zahl von 0 pro Tag, die nötig ist'. The red warning card says 'Können Sie es sich leisten, falschzuliegen? Schlimmster Fall: +100 €'. When the cost to cover is negative, say 'plus 10,03 € pro Tag, weil wechselnde Stammgäste mehr bringen'. Rephrase 'pays' as 'Das erreicht die nötigen {be} pro Tag'. When the worst case is ≥ 0, use the neutral card style and the heading 'Selbst im schlimmsten Fall kein Verlust'. Why: 'Why this changed' must explain a mechanism in plain German for the owner's real numbers, not only for the demo. Done when: a /try run with those values shows no '− −' and no alarm styling on a positive worst case.
